format: BRHCOL02; little-endian int32 mesh count, name UTF-8 byte count/name, vertex count, float32 x/y/z/r/g/b/a per vertex. Then int32 pose count/body vertex count; for each pose float32 seconds followed by x/y/z float32 for every body vertex. Coordinates are canonical game metres, not renderer-local import units.
scope: Independent neutral surface and linear color reference for Unity import; alpha is a bare-surface mask, never opacity.
